paper.title: R-Zero: Self-Evolving Reasoning LLM from Zero Data
paper.central_claim: R-Zero co-evolves a Challenger and a Solver from one base LLM with GRPO and self-consistency pseudo-labels, with no external tasks/labels, improving math (+6.49 on Qwen3-4B-Base) and general reasoning.

evidence.quote: In the Challenger training phase, the Challenger is trained via GRPO to generate difficult questions.
In the Solver training phase, the Solver is fine-tuned with GRPO on a filtered set of these challenging questions generated by the now-frozen Challenger, using the pseudo-labels voted by itself.
evidence.support_explanation: Solver is weight-fine-tuned; generated data is only a training set.

evidence.quote: The entire framework is self-supervised, requiring no human intervention.
evidence.support_explanation: No non-weight retained harness component (prompt/skill/tool/memory/workflow) is part of the loop.

signatures.operation: Challenger GRPO on uncertainty reward -> sample 8k questions -> filter by 3-7/10 agreement -> Solver GRPO -> repeat
signatures.output: Updated Challenger/Solver weights; filtered question set (training data)
